findings.title: Bind downloaded archive bytes to their pinned artifact IDs/digests.
findings.initial_problem: Workflow selected artifact names/run IDs while the script checked separate metadata IDs/digests. Actual evidence archive bytes were not enforced against the pin.
findings.resolution: Workflow now invokes an exact-ID GET through the normal gh Actions API. Both outer archive sizes/SHA-256 values and complete inventories must pass before either archive is extracted. Staging independently rechecks the outer archives and binds the complete extracted file inventory/bytes back to them.
findings.verification: Reviewed actual API arguments and extraction ordering. Tests cover wrong size, same-size corruption, extracted-file mutation, exact-ID binary streaming, unsafe ZIP inventories and download failure without extraction/retry. Raw signed-URL errors are not printed.

findings.title: Address the actual write by the verified release ID.
findings.initial_problem: The preflight checked releases/{release_id}, but gh release upload v1.10.0 re-resolved a tag for the mutation.
findings.resolution: Each upload is a POST to a generated constant-host https://uploads.github.com/repos/{fixed_repository}/releases/{pinned_positive_release_id}/assets endpoint with an encoded fixed asset name. It does not use an API-provided URL or resolve a tag to choose the write target. Per-file draft/prerelease/notes/tag checks and digest/size readbacks remain.
findings.verification: Tests assert the exact scheme, host, repository, release ID, method and encoded name in each actual command. A concurrent tag retarget cannot redirect the write to another release; later writes stop on detected tag/draft drift or server digest mismatch.

assessment.fail_closed_template: Unknown source run attempt, release ID/notes SHA, both artifact identities/digests/sizes and all five asset facts cause load_pins to fail before remote access. The reviewed template still has null pins and cannot execute a transfer.
assessment.source_and_evidence: Requires exact completed source review/checker bytes, raw 499-case source XML with precisely the two allowed skips, raw eight-case capsule XML without skips, all twenty summary gates, a matching raw 572-case upstream report with zero errors/failures/skips, exact module/resource closure, and both reviewed frozen IR report checks. All 24 module and 40 resource pins independently match actual reviewed product bytes.
assessment.review_chain: Exactly source plus one cumulative ci_delta is represented. The ci_delta base_revision must equal the source review revision and its reviewed_revision must equal the candidate source. Future source/CI updates must preserve this chain or receive a reviewed chain-structure update.
assessment.local_bytes: Exactly five fixed regular files are permitted. Each size/SHA and the complete SHA256SUMS text must match immutable pins. The outer evidence/release ZIPs and extracted inventories are revalidated before staging; traversal, absolute/drive paths, links/special files, encryption, case collisions and file/directory conflicts are rejected.
assessment.remote_identity: Checks public repository ID/name/visibility without modifying visibility, exact completed successful source run/workflow/attempt/job and successful artifact steps, skipped private-upload step, exact nonexpired artifact metadata, existing draft/prerelease ID, pinned notes, exact source target and bounded preexisting annotated-tag chain.
assessment.resume_and_writes: Only exact existing uploaded asset size/digest records are skipped. Unknown/duplicate/incomplete/mismatched assets fail closed. Missing files are uploaded through the pinned release-ID endpoint without clobber, followed by per-file and final complete server digest readbacks.
assessment.workflow_authority: Dispatch-only workflow restricted to the exact repository/delivery ref; job token permissions are actions:read and contents:write. It uses normal GitHub APIs and makes no release creation/edit/publication/deletion, tag creation, rebuild or visibility-change call. The old 1.9.2 publisher and all suite/runtime/capsule bytes are unchanged.
assessment.approval_separation: All success reports retain candidate_artifact_approved=false, independent artifact review required after download, Excel/equipment false and equipment/final-control HOLD. Logic acceptance does not approve final pins, candidate artifact contents or public publication.
